scope.scenario: The new case configures the active grant's maximumSourceFileBytes=4,096. The scripted peer writes exactly 4,096 bytes, attempts a 4,097-byte retry, reads back the retained candidate, and completes. The ACP write ceiling and patch, staging, context, and patch-count budgets have headroom; the ACP read ceiling equals the 4,096-byte candidate, so readback is admitted at equality. The policy audit must report POLICY_DENIED for the oversized mutation grant. The run also executes the exact patch-byte, filesystem write-byte, and filesystem read-byte retry controls.
scope.candidate: The active validator receives the exact MODIFIED candidate, verifies its source digest, and throws the expected sentinel. Receipt and rejected assessment linkage, unchanged accepted source/head, cleared pending state, and verified process/sandbox cleanup are asserted.
qualificationLimits: scripted ACP fixture and Generated C repair profile only
